# exo_management_scope (Resource)

Manages the ManagementScope object via New-ManagementScope / Get-ManagementScope / Set-ManagementScope / Remove-ManagementScope.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.
- `recipient_restriction_filter` (String) Maps to the -RecipientRestrictionFilter parameter.

### Optional

- `exclusive` (Boolean) Maps to the -Exclusive parameter.
- `recipient_root` (String) Maps to the -RecipientRoot parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `identity` (String) Identity used to target the object in cmdlets.
